note: Adds a _has_phase TypeGuard helper and uses it in both _cohort_progress and the unresolved comprehension, removing the inline negated double lookup.
Moves the private _single_line helper out of tasks/email.py into posthog/email.py as single_line and imports it from there.
Extracts _mirrored_source_property(field_type, context) and calls it from both _substitute_value_read and _masked_mirrored_column.
Adds description to DESCRIBED_ASPECTS, introduces an ASPECT_WORDING record driving head/tail clauses and a single loop, and drops the descriptionOnly block.
Declares an abstract _flag_evaluations_columns table in tables.hcl that both flag_evaluations and sharded_flag_evaluations extend; golden regenerated.
Replaces env-config gate with a team-level property_matching_version; request carries expected_property_matching_version and a mismatched page returns 409.
Splits the filter closure into .inspect() for divergence telemetry followed by .filter() for the realtime routing predicate.
Makes verbs.count optional with fallback to verbs.detail and removes the duplicated count strings from the three listOrCount callers.
Swaps the governor's asyncio.Lock for a threading.Lock; no change to the default concurrency source or warning logging.
Replaces the hand-rolled UUID regex and body checks on the cancel route with a zod schema using z.string().uuid() and a refine.
Hoists renderDetailWithLinks into lib/utils, used by both BlastRadiusErrorMessage and EmptyStates; trims the duplicated component tests.
Only expands doc comments explaining why valueBounds stays separate from valueDomain; no code change folding it into valueDomain.
Adds scopes_not_covered helper in permissions.py next to get_authenticator_scopes, used by APIScopePermission and secret key issuance.
Makes usageBatch a required dependency and drops optional chaining; the source label still uses apm, not renamed.
Renames the _ReadinessSpec field and log key from kind to readiness so it is not confused with the CohortBackfillKind metric label.
Adds run_check_for_team in processing.py forwarding dry_run from the registry; both the celery task and web-analytics doctor tool use it.
Deletes live/types.ts and moves LiveWidgetSeedPayload into liveWidgetTypes.ts.
Adds a ComputeShape frozen class for cpu/memory; rates remain duplicated and are not derived from the tasks pricing facade.
Turns CaptureSink into a newtype over Capture<CohortMembershipChange>, delegating produce/recorded and dropping the std::sync imports.
Adds a short_id field to AccessObjectRule for insight links; the resource set is not tied to the side panel availability logic.
